outcome: endosonographic morphology of the anal sphincter
cohort: 100 Black African and Indian women delivering at two hospitals in the Pietermaritzburg area
finding: Occult anal sphincter injuries and reduced anal pressures occur after delivery, irrespective of the mode of delivery, even without clinically detected trauma.
mod_finding: Internal sphincter defects were more common among primiparous and multiparous women delivering vaginally.
